messages.subject: For Rob Davis | Global healthcare, government relations and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Merck Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Robert M. Davis, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Merck's global medicines and vaccines portfolio operates across governments, regulators, health systems and major investment priorities. That stakeholder environment aligns closely with my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, regulatory stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Merck's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Merck & Co.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
